entries.reason: the header's own rule is that the array should be empty when selectionLimit is 1 or no photo library is specified, and this port's configuration never names one - -initWithPhotoLibrary: takes a library and does not keep it, because iOS 6's library is not an application's own - so the picker preselects nothing, which is the case the header describes
